title: Supplier v1
description: config/supply/suppliers/<id>.json (PADRAO-DEV F7c, D-320): a supplier of the Fornecimento system (a SUP of the engineering model): an account or a source of third-party components, its owner, the ecosystems of components it supplies and the budget requirement its spend is measured against. Never a credential value.

owner.description: Who answers for the account: Daniel for a paid account or a login, a domain of AGENTS.md otherwise.

kind.description: account: a paid or logged-in service the engine runs on; registry: a source of packages; platform: both.

ecosystems.description: The DEP ecosystems whose components it supplies.

budget.description: The requirement its spend is measured against.

tools.description: Toolchain tools it supplies, where they differ from the toolchain ecosystem's supplier.
